title: Evaluating Drug-Drug Interactions by Constructing Advanced Machine Learning Models of ABC Transporter Inhibitors.
summary:
The primary open-access article reports ML models for ABC-transporter inhibitor risk and external candidate predictions checked through experimental validation or literature; the finding is bounded to inhibitor/DDI-risk identification and does not establish clinical outcomes. Published in Journal of Chemical Information
and Modeling.
